x: Right to vote and to be elected is a constitutional right (Art. 326, given effect by the RP Acts) – the UPSC 2017 official key. NextGen calls it a statutory right (RPA s.62), and the option 'Legal Right' reflects Kuldip Nayar (2006); 'constitutional right' follows the official key and Anoop Baranwal (2023).
source: mrunal.org UPSC Prelims 2017 official answerkey (constitutional right); NextGen Polity - APPSC Exams (src/polity/nextgen-polity-full.txt) p.174

dispute: UPSC 2017's official key is 'Constitutional right' (Art. 326). Many books and the Supreme Court (Kuldip Nayar 2006, Jyoti Basu 1982) call it a statutory/legal right under the Representation of the People Act 1951; the 2023 Anoop Baranwal ruling also spoke of it as a constitutional right.
